name: create-starter
description: Scaffold and audit Starter Series projects — slash commands, skill, MCP server, and CLI with release / CD / security audit primitives.
long_description: Downloads a Starter Series template (Discord bot, Telegram bot, Docker deploy, MCP server, and more), substitutes placeholders, handles Python package renames, and runs git init. Input is Zod-validated, extraction is atomic via sibling tmp directory, and downloads have retry/timeout/size limits. Beyond scaffolding, surfaces release / CD / security audit primitives (audit_release, audit_cd, audit_security) and a seed_security_guidance generator — all callable as slash commands, MCP tools, or CLI subcommands.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all available Starter Series project templates

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Scaffold a new project from a Starter Series template

tools.name: audit_release
tools.description: Diagnose release-readiness against the Starter Series quality bar (matched starter, version-vs-tag drift, CHANGELOG drift, publish-workflow kind)

tools.name: audit_cd
tools.description: Check per-destination publish drift across npm, PyPI, Open VSX, VS Marketplace, AMO, and GitHub Releases via public read APIs

tools.name: audit_security
tools.description: Check baseline CI security hygiene (gitleaks, CodeQL, dependency audit, license check, --ignore-scripts, Dependabot, secret-scanning, claude-code-security-review, claude-security-guidance.md)

tools.name: seed_security_guidance
tools.description: Generate a starter claude-security-guidance.md at the repo root, tailored to the detected Starter Series template. Consumed in-session by Anthropic's Claude Code Security Guidance Plugin.

tools.name: add_component
tools.description: Lift a starter's CI/CD layer (ci / security / dependabot / maintenance) into an existing repo without re-scaffolding — dry-run by default with a per-file plan; the remediation half of the audit loop
